summary: Vora TTS feature verification — backend 14/14 new pytest cases + full 36/36 suite pass; frontend end-to-end flow verified at 390x844 (login → settings → voice list → preview → reader → play/next/stop → home regression). POST /api/tts/page returns {url:'/api/tts/audio/<sha256>.mp3'}; cache hit on repeat call (both runs < 5s, same url). page_index out-of-range/-1, unknown book, and other user's book → 404; invalid voice → 400 with 'Voce non valida'; missing auth → 401. POST /api/tts/preview {voice:'coral'} returns url. GET /api/tts/audio/{64hex}.mp3 serves audio/mpeg with ID3/MPEG header; bad shape → 404; non-existent key → 404; endpoint is public (unauthenticated). Frontend Settings shows all 11 natural voices (coral/sage/fable/onyx/ballad/verse/nova/shimmer/echo/alloy/ash), no pitch slider, rate slider + 4 presets intact; tapping a voice fires /api/tts/preview and persists the choice (verified end-to-end by subsequent reader call using the chosen voice); 'Prova voce' button triggers /api/tts/preview + GET audio successfully. Reader opens Test Scan book (5d8d8071fb794c308393a02664b0076a), tapping reader-play-button issues POST /api/tts/page → 200 then GET audio → 200, no reader-voice-error appears; next moves to page 2 and auto-plays its audio (new cached entry generated for page 1). Regression: login, home with upload & scan CTAs, tab navigation, Test Scan book row still work. Deprecated packages detected: none (expo-audio is in use; expo-av is NOT present).

issues: React Native accessibilityState={{checked}} on Pressable is NOT emitted as aria-checked on Expo web, so screen-reader users on web cannot tell which voice is the active one from ARIA alone (visual border/background still indicates it). Native iOS/Android VoiceOver/TalkBack are unaffected. Low priority; consider adding aria-checked / role=radio manually via accessibilityValue or a Platform.OS==='web' prop pass-through.

settings-rate-preset-1.0 is rendered as data-testid="settings-rate-preset-1" because JS number→string coercion drops trailing zeros (template literal `${1.0}` === '1'). Non-blocking, but makes automated testing of the 1.0x preset harder — consider testID={`settings-rate-preset-${r.toFixed(2)}`} or a stable string key.

action_items: Optional: stabilise rate-preset testIDs so the 1.0x preset is detectable from the DOM (e.g. r.toFixed(2) or hardcoded strings).
Optional (web a11y): forward accessibilityState.checked to aria-checked on web for the voice radio Pressables so screen-reader users on web preview know which voice is selected.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py TTS cache key correctly includes text|voice|rate(1.0)|model|format|instructions so model/instructions changes invalidate without colliding with legacy entries.
tts_page re-applies the reader's non-empty filter before indexing — matches the frontend behaviour and keeps page_index consistent between UI and TTS.
/api/tts/audio/{key}.mp3 validates key matches ^[0-9a-f]{64}$ before any DB lookup — guards against path traversal.
Fallback from gpt-4o-mini-tts → tts-1 is implemented and switches ballad/verse → coral since those voices are mini-only (correct).
Frontend shares a single AudioPlayer across the app (naturalVoice.ts) so switching screens or picking another voice stops the previous playback — avoids overlapping audio.
api.ts wraps /tts/page and /tts/preview with a 120s AbortController timeout — matches server's 90s synthesis timeout + storage upload latency.
